_about: CURATED (hand-written, NOT generated by knowledge_sync). Breakdown of the customer-facing app modules (the menuLaundy customer app is the reference implementation) and the rules for giving a new company a customer page. Served by the MCP tool get_customer_app_modules. When the menuLaundy repo changes, update this file in the same change; tests/test_customer_app_modules.py checks every endpoint here against Backend/backend_routes.json.json.

referenceApp.stack: Vite + React 18 + Ionic React 8 (tabs) + Tailwind, React Router v5 (IonReactRouter). NOT the POSVending MVVM layout: pages are single files under src/pages, API calls in src/api through src/api/client.ts get/post.
referenceApp.deploy: Azure Static Web Apps; branch developement = work, main = production (auto-deploys).
referenceApp.tenancy: One deployment = one company. The company comes from VITE_COMPANY_ID (src/api/rewards.ts COMPANY_ID); the backend host from VITE_API_URL. Never hardcode either.
referenceApp.tabBar: App.tsx: Inicio /home · Reservar /reservar · Mi QR /qr · Soporte /soporte · WhatsApp /whatsapp. Mis Puntos /puntos and Recompensas /recompensas are routes reached from Inicio.

deliveryModels.when: The company is NOT served by any existing customer app deployment (new business, new brand, or its own domain).
deliveryModels.how: New Azure Static Web App built from the reference app's code with that company's VITE_COMPANY_ID, branding and the modules it enabled. Same repo and branches; per-company values come from env + backend data, never from a code fork. A fork is only acceptable when the business type needs screens the reference app doesn't have, and must be recorded as a decision (ADR).
deliveryModels.prerequisite: Everything listed under companyOnboarding.requiredData for each enabled module, and every module's hardcodedToday item it uses moved to backend data first (otherwise the new page shows the laundry's prices/hours).

deliveryModels.when: The company already has a customer page and wants another module (e.g. turn on Recompensas or Soporte).
deliveryModels.how: Enable the module's featureKey in dbo.companyFeatures for that companyId, load the module's per-company data, then show the module's tab/route only when the feature is enabled. No new deployment.
deliveryModels.prerequisite: The module's dependsOn modules are already enabled for the company.

featureFlags.rule: One row per (companyId, featureKey); missing row = DISABLED. The backend decides eligibility and refuses a disabled feature's actions; the frontend never decides eligibility from a companyId. dbo.companyModules is legacy (every company has every module) — don't use it for this.
featureFlags.status: The table is live (first feature SERVICE_COMPLETION_NOTICE). The CUSTOMER_APP_* keys below are NOT seeded yet and the reference app does not read companyFeatures yet: today every module is on for companyId 1. Adding the keys + a read endpoint is a PRD (module companyFeature) for the factory.
featureFlags.configJson: Per-feature settings live in configJson (never secrets, phones or customer data).

modules.name: Inicio de sesión por celular
modules.route: /login (and in place of every protected page via RequireLogin)
modules.purpose: Customer logs in with their phone; the client is kept on the device for 30 days. Required by every personal module.

endpoints.use: find the client by phone (tries the stored phone formats)

perCompanyData: Clients registered for the company (POS or WhatsApp registration).
rules: Phone-only, unverified login: clientId is client-asserted. Never expose another client's data by clientId alone without flagging it.
Salir must call clearClientSession() (logs out everywhere). Don't add new 'enter your phone' prompts — read the session.

modules.name: Inicio (lista de precios / pantalla de tienda)
modules.purpose: Public price list carousel, business hours, address, music video, shortcuts to Mis Puntos and to the other GMO apps. Also runs on the in-store screen.
perCompanyData: Price list per service and size
hardcodedToday: src/data/services.ts: slides (prices), businessHours, contactInfo (phone, WhatsApp, email, address), liveMusicVideos
rules: Before a second company uses this module, prices/hours/contact must come from backend data (products / companies / companiesBranch), not src/data/services.ts.

modules.name: Ticket digital
modules.purpose: Opens the sale receipt the POS uploaded to Blob Storage, from the link sent by WhatsApp/SMS.

modules.name: Mi QR
modules.purpose: The client's signed QR: shown at the register to earn/redeem, and scanned at the laundry machines to pay from the wallet.
perCompanyData: Machines (laundryDevices) only if the company has IoT machines; the QR also works at the register without them.
rules: Never build the QR in the app: the HMAC secret is backend-only and the machines reject anything else.

modules.name: Reservar
modules.purpose: Customer books a service for a date and time slot.

endpoints.use: create, list a date's bookings (slot availability), list the client's own
per-company service catalog (already used by the WhatsApp agent; the app should read it instead of its hardcoded list)

rules: Slot taken = same date + timeSlot + serviceType with status ≠ cancelled (mirrors sp_reservations).
Known PII exposure: availability downloads full reservations for a date — needs a backend availability endpoint before more companies use it.

modules.name: Mis Puntos
modules.purpose: Points balance, lifetime earned/redeemed, purchases that earned points, points activity — the same data as the POS client view (POSVending ClientDashboardPOS).

endpoints.use: ledger; purchases = EARN rows with referenceType 'ticket'

rules: Redemption happens in POSVendingV2 (cashier scans the QR); the customer app only shows status. Never auto-confirm money or points.

modules.name: Recompensas (tarjetas de sellos + descuentos)
modules.route: /recompensas (same page as /puntos, opened at the catalog)
modules.purpose: Stamp cards (buy N, get 1 free, per size/cycle) as compact rows, then points discounts, then how to redeem.

endpoints.use: active rewards: free_product (stamp cards) and discount_fixed / discount_pct
units per card + cycle (catalogItemId, productOptionChoiceId, choiceName, requiredUnits)

perCompanyData: Reward catalog items: stamp cards (freeProductId + requiredUnits) and points discounts
rules: Stamp rule text is built from requiredUnits, never from the typed name/description (names carried stale suffixes like '(4x3)').
Stamp cards fill per cycle: free per cycle = floor(unitsAvailable / requiredUnits). Use stampCycles() (mirrors POSVending src/utils/stampCycles.ts).

modules.name: Saldo y recarga
modules.purpose: Prepaid balance the machines charge, top-up by card (Stripe), cash at the register, or bank transfer.

endpoints.use: which top-up methods the company accepts (card / transfer CLABE)
company name on the transfer details
save the card after a top-up

perCompanyData: companyPaymentAccounts row for purpose wallet_topup (Stripe connected account and/or transfer CLABE)
rules: Payment-domain changes need an RFC against POSVending docs/p2p-direct-payments-architecture.md.
Top-ups credit the real net (Stripe balance_transaction); keep the Payment Element mounted during confirmPayment().
A live publishable key means test payments are real charges.

modules.name: Campana de avisos
modules.purpose: Reward ready, points earned/redeemed, low balance — built from the customer's own rewards and wallet data (no per-customer notification list exists yet).
rules: Only shows alert kinds for modules the company has enabled.

modules.name: Soporte (chat con el asistente virtual)
modules.purpose: In-app chat with the SAME agent that answers the company's WhatsApp (whatsapp_reservations via smartloans_backend modules/whatsappReservations.reply_to). No new agent.
perCompanyData: A whatsappChannels row for the company (the agent's state is per channel + phone)
Business data the agent reads (services, hours) — empty values reach the agent as NO REGISTRADO, never null
rules: Backend resolves the phone from clientId; never accept a phone from the request.
The web path must not send WhatsApp messages (SEND_CLIENT_QR, booking pushes) — answer in the chat instead.
Until /webSupportChat ships the page answers with a WhatsApp handoff; don't release it to production before.

modules.name: WhatsApp
modules.route: /whatsapp (tab opens wa.me directly; the page is the fallback)
modules.purpose: Opens the company's WhatsApp, where the virtual agent answers and staff can take over.
perCompanyData: Business WhatsApp number (Meta Cloud API channel)
Business hours and address shown on the page
rules: Generic prefilled text: no name or phone in the wa.me link (no PII in URLs).

modules.name: Apps GMO (POS, Préstamos, Juegos, Factory AI)
modules.purpose: Links to the rest of the GMO ecosystem, same order and icons as the POS login.
perCompanyData: Which ecosystem apps to show for the company

companyOnboarding.goal: When a new company comes in, collect everything below up front so the page (or the added module) can be configured without asking again.
steps: 1. Pick the delivery model: new_company_page or add_module_to_existing_page.
2. Pick the modules (by key). Add every module's dependsOn.
3. Collect companyOnboarding.requiredData for the company + each picked module's perCompanyData.
4. For every picked module with hardcodedToday items: those must move to backend data before this company goes live — each is a PRD for the factory, not a copy-paste of the laundry's values.
5. Seed dbo.companyFeatures rows for the picked featureKeys (missing row = disabled).

6. new_company_page only: create the Static Web App + env vars (VITE_COMPANY_ID, VITE_API_URL, VITE_POS_URL, VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY), verify at 375px and desktop, release via developement -> main.
7. Any module with status pending_backend stays hidden for the company until its endpoint ships.

company: Business type (laundry, retail, …) — decides which modules make sense
Domain / URL for the customer page
contact: Business WhatsApp number (Meta Cloud API) and phone
Business hours per weekday and closed days
catalog: Which services can be booked and their time slots
payments: Accepts wallet top-ups? Card (Stripe connected account) and/or transfer (CLABE holder + bank)
Stripe publishable key for the deployment
machines: Has IoT laundry machines? (laundryDevices) — decides the QR/wallet copy

rules: companyId is never a PRD field and never hardcoded in a page: it comes from VITE_COMPANY_ID in the app and is injected by SPs in the backend.
companyId 1 = Lavandería, 1008 = SmartLoans. Client #1 'Desconocido -1' is the POS walk-in default — never a real customer.
Reuse an existing module before generating a new one; a new module is added to this file in the same change.
UI copy is Spanish (es-MX); every async action shows a loader; mobile-first (375px) with no horizontal scroll.
